dogecoin.text:
People are thrown off from crypto because of the terminology and branding:

"Dogecoin", "Tokens", "Shitcoins", "Whitepapers" all connote complexity & informality - which isn't associated with trust & money.

If they knew what crypto stood for, we'd have faster adoption.
